metadata.title: Genetic engineering of Escherichia coli to enhance production of L-tryptophan

reference.title: Genetic engineering of Escherichia coli to enhance production of L-tryptophan

engineering_problem.problem_statement: Investigate how pta deletion, mtr deletion, and yddG overexpression, individually and in combination, affect L-tryptophan production and fermentation metabolism in E. coli TRTH0709/pMEL03 under 30-L fed-batch conditions.

engineering_reasoning.problem_definition: Investigate how pta deletion, mtr deletion, and yddG overexpression, individually and in combination, affect L-tryptophan production and fermentation metabolism in E. coli TRTH0709/pMEL03 under 30-L fed-batch conditions.

strain_transitions.purpose: Reduce acetate accumulation and improve L-tryptophan production
strain_transitions.reason_for_next_step: The paper's design rationale identifies acetate as an inhibitory byproduct and pta as part of an acetate-synthesis pathway.

strain_transitions.purpose: Reduce tryptophan uptake and intracellular tryptophan accumulation
strain_transitions.reason_for_next_step: The paper's rationale links lower intracellular amino-acid concentration to reduced feedback inhibition and higher extracellular accumulation.

strain_transitions.modification: Δmtr and yddG overexpression from pMEL03-Y
strain_transitions.purpose: Reduce tryptophan uptake and enhance tryptophan export
strain_transitions.reason_for_next_step: The study explicitly designed transport-system modification to lower intracellular tryptophan and increase extracellular production.

strain_transitions.modification: Δpta, Δmtr, and yddG overexpression from pMEL03-Y
strain_transitions.purpose: Combine acetate reduction, reduced tryptophan import, and enhanced tryptophan export
strain_transitions.reason_for_next_step: The Introduction states that all four recombinant strains were generated to investigate the effects of these manipulations on tryptophan production.

strain_transitions.purpose: Verify active YddG expression by 5-methyltryptophan sensitivity
strain_transitions.reason_for_next_step: The paper reports the plasmid-bearing strain was less sensitive to 5-MT, supporting active YddG expression.

identity.title: Genetic engineering of Escherichia coli to enhance production of L-tryptophan

article_type.original_experiment_scope: Construction of engineered E. coli strains, functional plasmid verification, and comparative 30-L fed-batch fermentation with metabolite and growth measurements.

design_fields.label: 研究目标
design_fields.value: Investigate how pta deletion, mtr deletion, and yddG overexpression, individually and in combination, affect L-tryptophan production and fermentation metabolism in E. coli TRTH0709/pMEL03 under 30-L fed-batch conditions.

design_fields.label: 研究假设
design_fields.value: Deleting pta should reduce acetate accumulation, while deleting mtr and overexpressing yddG should reduce intracellular tryptophan accumulation and feedback inhibition, thereby increasing extracellular L-tryptophan production and glucose conversion.

reasoning.notes: The paper states background rationale and the tested manipulations but does not present a single formal hypothesis sentence.
reasoning.inference_method: Bounded synthesis of the paper's stated rationale and interventions
reasoning.inference_rationale: The abstract and Introduction explicitly connect acetate reduction, reduced intracellular amino acid accumulation, and increased extracellular amino acid production before naming the tested pta, mtr, and yddG modifications.

reasoning.notes: MG1655 and MG1655-Y were used for the YddG verification assay; Par and its derivatives were used for fermentation.

value.pSV-709: pBR322 carrying aroG^fbr trpE^fbr DCBA serA tetR
value.Dmtr-Y: Par with Δmtr and yddG overexpression
value.Dpta/mtr-Y: Par with Δpta, Δmtr, and yddG overexpression
value.pMEL03-Y: pSTV28 carrying tktA, ppsA, and yddG

design_fields.label: 工程方法/干预手段
value: Lambda Red-mediated chromosomal deletion of pta and mtr using pKD46, pKD3-derived PCR fragments, and pCP20-mediated antibiotic-marker removal
PCR amplification of yddG followed by BamHI digestion and insertion into pMEL03 to construct pMEL03-Y
30-L fed-batch fermentation using combined pseudo-exponential and glucose-stat glucose feeding

value.description: pta deletion, mtr deletion, and yddG overexpression

value.role: Parental strain comparator under the same fermentation conditions
Comparator for the 5-MT sensitivity verification of pMEL03-Y-containing MG1655-Y

reasoning.notes: Parallel comparison is explicit in results figures and text, although the word 'control' is not used.

design_fields.label: 培养条件
design_fields.value: Seed culture: 30 mL seed medium in a 500-mL baffled flask at 36 °C, 200 rpm, 12 h. Seed fermenter: 30 mL inoculum into 3 L seed medium in a 5-L Biotech-2002 fermenter at 36 °C for 16 h. Production: 10% v/v inoculum into 18 L production medium in a 30-L fermenter at 36 °C, 20% dissolved oxygen, and pH 7.0 maintained with 25% w/w ammonium hydroxide. After initial glucose depletion, 80% w/v glucose was fed by combined pseudo-exponential and glucose-stat feeding.

value.seed_medium: 20 g/L glucose, 15 g/L yeast extract, 10 g/L ammonium sulfate, 0.5 g/L sodium citrate, 5 g/L MgSO4·7H2O, 1.5 g/L KH2PO4, 0.015 g/L FeSO4·7H2O, 0.1 g/L vitamin B1; pH 7.0
value.fermentation_medium: 20 g/L glucose, 1 g/L yeast extract, 4 g/L ammonium sulfate, 2 g/L sodium citrate, 5 g/L MgSO4·7H2O, 2 g/L KH2PO4, 0.1 g/L FeSO4·7H2O; pH 7.0
value.antibiotics_when_required: 100 μg/mL ampicillin, 30 μg/mL chloramphenicol, 50 μg/mL tetracycline

reasoning.notes: Antibiotic use during production fermentation is not explicitly specified.
No chemical inducer or amino-acid dosage was reported for the production experiment.
The total fed-batch duration and complete sampling schedule were not reported in the available text.

The paper states that all experiments were conducted in triplicate (statistical_analysis_p001), but it does not specify whether 'triplicate' denotes independent fermentations or another replicate level for each individual assay; therefore no unambiguous replicate value is projected here.

design_fields.label: 检测方法
value: Colony PCR confirmation of pta and mtr deletions

design_fields.label: 仪器
value: SBA-40C biosensor analyzer for glucose and lactate
Bioprofile 300A biochemical analyzer for acetate and pyruvate

design_fields.label: 分析方法
design_fields.value: Data were averaged as mean ± standard deviation. One-way analysis of variance followed by Dunnett's multiple comparison test was used; P<0.05 was considered significant.

value.L_tryptophan: Dpta/mtr-Y reached 48.68 g/L extracellular L-tryptophan versus 41.98 g/L for Par, a 15.96% increase.
value.growth: Dpta/mtr-Y achieved 50.53 g/L maximum DCW; genetic modifications reduced early specific growth rate but increased later specific growth rate relative to Par.
value.intracellular_tryptophan: Dmtr-Y reached the lowest reported intracellular L-tryptophan concentration, 1.78 μmol/g DCW.
value.acetate: Dpta/mtr-Y accumulated 0.95 g/L acetate, 46.63% lower than Par.
value.pyruvate_lactate: Dpta peaked at 2.8 mmol/L pyruvate and 33.7 mmol/L lactate; Dpta/mtr-Y excreted 2.5 mmol/L pyruvate and 29.9 mmol/L lactate.
value.glucose_conversion: Total glucose conversion rates were 20.68% for Dpta, 19.27% for Dmtr, 19.45% for Dmtr-Y, 21.87% for Dpta/mtr-Y, and 18.93% for Par.
